macros.name: alternative
macros.doc: Prints a comma-separated list delimited by vertical bars. Space around commas is not trimmed, and alternates are printed in \textup{\texttt{...}}.

macros.name: bool
macros.doc: Within a keys environment, \bool indicates a true/false value.

macros.name: bs
macros.doc: To write a literal backslash, use the \bs command.

macros.name: ctan
macros.doc: Typesets a package name with a link to ctan.org/pkg/⟨package⟩.

macros.name: email
macros.doc: Typesets an email address with a mailto: link.

macros.name: extension
macros.doc: Typesets a LaTeX package, option, file extension, etc. in \texttt.

macros.name: filename
macros.doc: Typesets a LaTeX package, option, file extension, etc. in \texttt.

macros.name: labeladvise
macros.doc: The list label for the advise environment is \labeladvise.

macros.name: meta
macros.doc: Prints ⟨placeholder⟩ in italics within angle-brackets. ltxguidex provides \meta as a synonym for \m.

macros.name: newnotice
macros.doc: Creates a new notice environment in the style of warning, note, and so on.

macros.name: noticestyle
macros.doc: \noticestyle is executed before the marker text (“warning,” “note,” etc.).

macros.name: pipe
macros.doc: To write literal pipe characters, use the \pipe command.

envs.name: desc
envs.doc: Describes a command or environment, setting it out into the margin and surrounding it with a frame.
